facts.fact: 藏品柜：娃娃残件/标本/发绺盒
facts.anchor: They swing open, the hinges rusted, revealing the broken treasures within
“It did not rain today,” my mother says
My mother moves, slowly, all limbs. “Then lie.”
“Anywhere,” she says, laying her head on my chest
trying on pieces of humanity as one would slip on shoes
I am wrapped in blankets, tucked in so tight I can scarcely breathe, like a shroud
There is no moonglow to soften the edges
I was famine-stripped long before my undeath
You are wanted, darling one, if not loved, then wanted
held there by a white moth
